optimized_sql:
WITH
cc_subject AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM comp_cast_type
    WHERE kind = 'cast'
),
cc_status AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM comp_cast_type
    WHERE kind LIKE '%complete%'
),
complete_cast_filtered AS (
    SELECT cc.movie_id
    FROM complete_cast AS cc
    JOIN cc_subject AS sub ON sub.id = cc.subject_id
    JOIN cc_status AS st ON st.id = cc.status_id
),
filtered_keywords AS (
    SELECT k.id
    FROM `keyword` AS k
    WHERE k.keyword IN ('superhero','marvel-comics','based-on-comic','tv-special','fight','violence','magnet','web','claw','laser')
),
keyword_movies AS (
    SELECT mk.movie_id
    FROM movie_keyword AS mk
    JOIN filtered_keywords AS fk ON fk.id = mk.keyword_id
),
rating_type AS (
    SELECT it.id
    FROM info_type AS it
    WHERE it.info = 'rating'
),
rating_movies AS (
    SELECT mi.movie_id, mi.info
    FROM movie_info_idx AS mi
    JOIN rating_type AS rt ON rt.id = mi.info_type_id
),
hero_characters AS (
    SELECT chn.id, chn.name
    FROM char_name AS chn
    WHERE chn.name IS NOT NULL
      AND (chn.name LIKE '%man%' OR chn.name LIKE '%Man%')
),
cast_with_character AS (
    SELECT ci.movie_id, ci.person_id, hc.name
    FROM cast_info AS ci
    JOIN hero_characters AS hc ON hc.id = ci.person_role_id
)
SELECT MIN(d.name) AS character_name,
       MIN(d.info) AS rating,
       MIN(d.title) AS complete_hero_movie
FROM (
    SELECT t.id AS movie_id,
           t.title,
           cwc.name,
           rm.info
    FROM title AS t
    JOIN kind_type AS kt ON kt.id = t.kind_id AND kt.kind = 'movie'
    JOIN keyword_movies AS km ON km.movie_id = t.id
    JOIN cast_with_character AS cwc ON cwc.movie_id = t.id
    JOIN name AS n ON n.id = cwc.person_id
    JOIN rating_movies AS rm ON rm.movie_id = t.id
    WHERE t.production_year > 2000
) AS d
JOIN complete_cast_filtered AS ccf ON ccf.movie_id = d.movie_id
